review_notes: I read the whole target file (42 lines). I also read BondSigns.lean and SignedSigns.lean, which hold the closest related proofs. Neither overlap meets the rubric's bar for a shared lemma. I did not search the rest of the repository for further similar proofs, because the rubric asks for repetition across proofs and the file's own sibling files were the plausible candidates.
